tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje nag po zhal bzhi pa'i gtor skyong dam tshig bskang gsor nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris blo chung mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsa turmu kha ye/ shing khyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer drug la sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros mched nas dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i sku rim du stobs 'phrog rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag dam tshig bskang gso kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i mdzad pa'i gtor ma zhi drag gi cho ga gnam lcags 'bar ba bzhin la tshad thub kyi bla ma gong ma so so'i yig cha nas kha bskang te gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na bzhugs pa'i mgon po che chung gi dbyangs rol 'jug tshul sogs phyag len bsdebs bsgrigs su bkod pa la/ thog mar sgrub khang gi steng ngam phyi rol ji ltar 'os par phyi rten zung 'jug kyi cho ga dam pa kun dga' grags kyi gsung rab rnams dang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha/ nged rang nas brtsams pa'i gzungs bskyed chog rnams lhan cig tu gung bsgrigs nas nyams su blangs ba la/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i sku ji ltar rigs pa bzhugs su gsol ba'i drung du stegs mtho bar gtor ma dam rdzas gsum bsdus bskang / zhal gyi dmar gtor gtor dgur bcas/ de'i mdun du'ang gtor ma de 'dra ba chung ngu zhig chu bzhi'i sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ phud chang / sgrub pa po rnams kyi mdun du rdo dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ bum pa gcig me long khrus dar sbyong chas/ rnga rol sil/ dung rkang gling g.yab dar sogs ji ltar 'os pa dang / phyi rten 'jim pa la bzos pa rnams ras kyi khar 'bru bkram pa'i steng du rten rnams la zhal phyogs par bzhugs su gsol ba'i drung du/ ras dar kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rnga ma dkar nag rnams kyi phon po dang /

phye mar gser skyems tshad ldan thod pa'i nang du khrag chang sbyar ba rnams bshams/ gzhan yang mda' dar dar lcog sogs spyan gzigs sna mang byung na'ang mchog tu legs/ nyer drug gi nyi rtse la cho ga tshugs par gnas yo byin brlabs sngon 'gro'i bdag bskyed lam dus rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bsdus nas bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i zhes pa nas nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du zhes pa'i bar spyi 'gre la/ paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zhing / g.yon des yu bar byas pa'i dkur brten pa rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa stag gis pags pa'i shams thab can zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes pa nas/ thugs dkar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ sogs chu bzhi dang nyer mchod rol mo rnams sngags tsam gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza oṃ badzra gauo rī nas ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ni ri sogs gong bzhin mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ mtshan re re 'gor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer mchod rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/

dril gsil rol chen dang bcas pas dkar mo ri dwags nas/ 'khyud pa nyid kyi bar/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs shlau ka gcig rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba dmar po gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas bum nang gi lha dmar lam lam song ste sku'i ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ a mṛ ta brgya rtsa bzlas pa'i mthar gong ltar mchod bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang shlau ka gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gis lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ gtor bsngo rgyun bzhin/ bshags pa gcig bskang ba thugs dam shur ma la/ lha mchog mar khaṃ gdangs/ bstod pa ma skyes mkha' klong ma/ phur srung bstod pa'i mjug gsum brdeg len can/ de nas slob dpon rnams bzhengs la sbyong chas phyi rten gyi drung du bshams la zhi ba dang zhi drag phyed ma/ drag po'i sbyong ba rnams dkyus bzhin la bden bdar gyi skabs su/ hūm̐ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i zhes pa nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis zhes pa'i bar tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rab bzhin la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen srin mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyi rten phun sum tshogs pa 'di rnams 'dzugs pa la bar du gcod pa'i sogs gzungs 'dzugs dkyus bzhin rten khrus gsol ba nas gzungs rnams la khrus gsol rgyas par gang la ser sna ma dang bcas pa'i mthar/ bzang khrus byas la gral la 'khod/ gtor ma gtor gdugs can a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su/ zhes pa nas/

ha ha dgod pa'i dur dar lung gnyen kyi pho brang / kha'u brag rdzongs/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang / khrod rnams nas rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ yang gzhan la bcom dung sngon 'gro'i bcom rol bswo ring bzhin rkang gling bcas/ lha mchog ma'i dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin gyi mthar/ hūm̐ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang rnam sprul las sogs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i spyan 'dren gyi mthar chems brdung sngags bcas/ rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal yas khang sogs byon skyems kyi mthar gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la gdan la 'khod/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si sogs dam bzhag gtor bsngo bzhin/ mdun gyi gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ sngags thung la gtor sngags btags pa bdun/ sngags ring lan gsum gyis dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ sngags thung gi mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs 'phrin bcol gsung rgyun bzhin/ de nas rnga brdung zhing bka' bsgo'i dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ bde dga' rgya mtsho kun ster ba'i sogs shlau ka gnyis la dbyangs/ 'jig rten 'jig pa byed pa yi nas/ 'dir gshegs drag po'i phrin las sgrub kyi bar g.yang gzhi bla re'i 'dur gdang bzhin/ mjug tu gsum brdeg len can bcas/ bsdus pa/ kho bos byas pa'i gzungs bskyed chog rgyas par grub nas/ phyi rten rnams la gzungs thag btags pa'i sne rten rnams kyi drung du bzhag

dpon slob rnams bzhengs la/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid nas/ ye shes khro bo che la phyag 'tshal lo'i bar rgyun bzhin/ phan bde'i bstan pa skyong mdzad cing / /log 'dren 'dul mdzad bstan pa la/ /rab zhugs thams cad bu bzhin du/ /skyong mdzad nag po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phyag bya 'os pa shlau ka gcig dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ zhes sogs bshags pa gsum gyi mthar/ khyed thugs ma gdangs ring / dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi sku'i dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags nas/ bzod pa dam pa bzhes kyi bar/ gral la 'khod/ bcom dung dang bcom rol gsum brdeg lugs sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs ring bcas/ hūm̐ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' yi sogs/ shlau ka gcig dril bu me tog dar sna tshogs zhes pa nas/ sa steng kun tu rgyas par mdzod kyi bar 'dur gdangs gsum gsum brdeg len can/ bsdus pa/ yang bzhengs la/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril dang me tog 'thor/ gzhan rnams kyis rnga rol gser skyems 'thor/ sha chen gu gul gyi dud pa dang bcas/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal ldan ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po zhes pa nas/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha zhes pa'i bar gzungs chog bzhin la/ zhing skyong nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ phyi rten phun sum tshogs pa 'di rnams zhes pa nas/ mdangs 'phrog lus kyang shig cig ces pa'i mthar drag rol drag dung dang bcas gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi zhes pa nas/ bsgrub par mdzod cig gi bar brjod la slob dpon gyis chos skyong gi sku rnams la me tog gtor/ de ltar lan gsum gyi mthar/ gsum brdeg bsdus pa len can byas la/ 'dur gdangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ bya nag gshog pa'i rtsal gyis dgra bgegs lus zhes sogs mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsungs la kho bos tshig cung zad bcos pa de nyid brjod pa'i mthar/

tshig rol byas la rnga rol bzhag slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rjes rdor dril dang bcas pa'i gtor ma gtor gdugs bzung la/ dpon slob thams cad mgrin gcig tu/ hūm̐ bya nag spyi bo'i gtsug nyid du/ /zhing skyong gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob nas/ /khams gsum ma lus 'dul gyur cig 'di nas bzung tshig bcad rnams kyi mthar dril bu gsil/ oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de bzhin du rta mchog nas mi nag gi bar la'ang tshig bsgyur la sngags dang bcas pa brjod pa'i mthar/ hūm̐ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs kyi rjes su zhal gyi sngags thung dang / sa ma ya sma ra si sogs dam bzhag gi sngags btags la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ grub chen dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ dge ba can ma/ dar ma grags/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags gzungs kyi dpal ba thugs sras bzang po rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sangs rgyas mchog pa/ chos rje skyabs mchog rgyal mtshan/ lcags mo bkra shis seng ge tshar chen man chad 'dra bar byas pa ni gdams ngag yongs rdzogs kyi brgyud pa'o/ /zhang dkon mchog dpal nas rje btsun rdo rings pa yan chad bsnyen bsgrub kyi rjes gnang brgyud pa'o/ /zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/

bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ grub dbang bkra shis seng ge tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' lhun grub/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / gzhan yang sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams la zhes pa nas/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston cig ces pa'i mthar drag rol dang bcas gzungs so so spyi bor gtor dbang bskur la zhal gyi sngags thung brjod/ khrag chang phye mar rnams nas phyi rten rnams kyi kha dang gzungs la cung zad gtor/ dbang bskur zin pa dang / slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rjes rdor dril thogs/ rol mo gsum brdeg rgyas pa len can byas la/ rnga brdung 'dur gdangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ rnam dag rgyu rkyen las grub cing / /sogs shlau ka gcig gi mthar/ tshig rol chems brdung sngags bcas phyi rten rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag yang gsum brdeg rgyas pa len can byas la/ rnga rol bzhag nas/ las kyi rdo rjes gzungs rnams la phye mar cung zad re 'thor zhing /

dpon slob rnams kyis dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis thugs dgongs 'di la dgongs shig ces pa nas/ rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod/ ces pa'i bar gzungs chog bzhin brjod la/ zhwa gyon/ dril gsil me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa brjod pa'i mthar rol mo'i sgra rgya cher byas la gzungs thag bsdus/ gtor 'bul nas gzhug chog gi bar phyag len bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun sogs brjod pa tsam gyi khyad par ro/ /de ltar nyi ma phyed tsam la grol bar byas/ de nas gung tshig grub rjes cho ga tshugs pa yin zhing sbyor ba rten dang mchod gtor bsham tshul kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i yig cha nang bzhin la sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos bzhengs par mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bla brgyud dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis bzhengs par mdzad pa'i drag yol sngags thung / lda ldi sogs gnas khang gi babs dang bstun par bkram zhing / khrab rmog ji ltar 'tshams pa dang / nang rten mtshon pa'i sngags pa'i gsob/ yon tan phrin las kyi rten mtshon pa'i gser dngul zangs lcags dkar cha/ rin po che las grub pa'i manḍal gos dar zab/ stag gzig gung gsum gyi pags pa sogs stegs dang sa gzhi ji ltar 'os pa la mdzes par bkram pa'i byang phyogs su stegs mtho bar ras dar gyis bkab cing / 'bru sna tshogs bkram pa'i khar g.yas phyogs su mañdzi la dngul gyi maṇḍal khru 'khor ma'i dbus su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi dang / phyogs mtshams brgyad du zlum po re/ de'i steng du 'bras dri bzang 'o ma rnams lhan cig tu sbrus pa'i dbus su tshom bu phul gang tsam gyi tshod dang /

phyogs mtshams brgyad du phul phyed tsam gyi tshom bu bkod pa kyai rdor mdun bskyed gyi rten dang / de'i g.yon phyogs su mañdzi'i khar man ngag bzhin sgrub pa'i rten rdo la tshon gyis chos 'byung 'bri na 'di rang gi gzhung bzhin yin kyang / gzhan gyi lag mi 'phar ba sogs kyi khyad byung tshe gri khrag gi dbus su gru gsum che ba rtse dang zur ston phyogs rten rdo nyid kyis dbyibs dang mthun par byas pa'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon rnams su chos 'byung chung ngu rtse phyir bstan re bris la 'bru nag gi tshom bu la rjes gnang gi dus kyi nas nag bsres pa gri khrag chang bdud rtsi ril bu'i khu bas sbrus pa gru gsum gyi dbyibs can dbus su che ba dang / phyogs bzhi chung ba re bkod la rtse mo byang du bstan te dar nag gam gos nag gi gur phub la rdul mi 'chor bar bya/ man ngag phal cher 'di'i mthar phyag mtshan bshams par gsungs kyang ma shong na dam tshig gso gtor ma'i mtha' bskor du bshams kyang 'gal ba med par sems/ de'i 'og gi stegs bu la/ dam rdzas bcu tshar snod so sor dang / gtor gur bcas/ de'i 'og stegs bu ma bkram bskang nag po mchod rten rnams so so rgyan gzabs ma mda' dar tshon bcas/ thun gtor phud chang bcas/ de'i drung du chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bgrang tshar/ de'i mdun gyi gzhir stegs dang padma 'bri tshul gtor ma bkod pa'i rim pa rnams gzhung bzhin byas pa'i sa stegs kyi g.yas g.yon la phyi rten rnams cha mnyam nas bkod/ stegs bu'i steng g.yas nas mdun bskor du 'brus bkang ba'i snod la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par/ gri gug rtse gsum/ mdung / ral gri/ rkang gling / bum pa/ thod phreng / thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rnams bshams/ gri snying dngos sam/ zan rnams 'jim pa la gzugs bcos pa gtor chen gyi mda' dar mgul la 'dogs pa'am/ yang na mdun du thod pa 'bru sogs kyis bkang ba'i khar bzhag

de'i mdun du stegs kyi khar sha mar la bcos pa'i dum bu dang / nas nag 'bras dkar/ sran ma rnams btsos pa'i chan ting ngam gtor theb la sogs par blug thun gtor snying gzugs ma lnga/ gser skyems/ drag po'i mchod pa rgyun bzhin la dbang lnga'i me tog thod pa'i nang du gzugs rnams nyin re bzhin bcos nas kha gsos na rnam par gsal zhing lag len bde ba zhig yong 'dug gzhan tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'ang bshams/ dngos gzhi ni sgrub pa po rnams gral la 'khod la gnas yo byin brlabs sngon 'gro'i bdag bskyed lam dus rgyas pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdus nas gtor ma la btsugs pa'i shog ling rnams sla nga'i nang du ang rim bzhin bsdus la/ slob dpon gyi drung du mgo bstan nas bzhag la dgug gzhug gtor chen 'byung ba ltar lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje thugs kar bzung / dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol/ zhal gyi sngags thung bzla zhing gzhan rnams kyi drag rol gyi ring la las kyi rdo rjes ang rim bzhin gtor ma la btsugs nas rol mo gsum brdeg len can byas rgyas pa la bzhag kye rdor maṇḍal sgrub mchod phyag len bzhin mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor bsngo'i bar/ de nas zhal dor la/ dur khrod bdag po nas bshags pa'i bar nyer drug dus gtor bzhin/ bskang ba'ang dus gtor sor bzhag la gang gi rang bzhin ma'i rjes su dur bdag dang las mgon gyi spyan 'dren/ bstod pa la dpal ldan srin gsum ma dor/ sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i phrin bcol gyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas la bzhag lha'i tshogs rnams nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ de nas mdun gyi mchod pa bsangs sbyangs gtor ma byin rlabs dang / rten rdo rje'i steng gi tshom bu bskyed chog rnams gzhung bzhin la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang /

kha'u brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rnga rol thogs la dpon slob rnams bzhengs/ bcom dung sngon 'gro'i bcom rol so ring lugs/ lha mchog ma'i dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin tshig rnams kyang gdan sa 'di nyid kyi gsung rgyun bzhin la phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren no'i rjes su rol mo mi len par sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol zhes sbrel ba'i rjes su/ lha mchog ma hā kā la gshegs su gsol zhes sogs gzhung bzhin brjod pa'i mthar tshig rol/ byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i la dbyangs/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang rnam sprul 'dur ma'i mthar/ tshig rol chems brdung sngags bcas/ ro bcud brgyad ldan gser skyems gtsang ma dang sogs shlau ka gcig tshig rol chems brdung dang / oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bi nī/ tsanda lī/ rakṣa sī/ siṅga lī/ de wi sa pa ri wā ra badzra a pa na tiṣṭhantu/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs rgyas pa bcas byas la gral la 'khod/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya sma ra si sogs dam bzhag gtor bsngo bzhin la/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i rjes su thal mo sbyar nas/ gzhan yang stobs 'phrog rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i mgon po zhes pa nas/ dge legs dang dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes pa'i bar lan gcig brjod la/ rnga brdung zhing mgon po 'khor dang ma'i rang dbyangs dang bcas/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i mchod dbyangs thung ba zhes kyang gsungs/

'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegs kun zhes sogs shlau ka gsum la dbyangs/ de phyir 'dur gdangs kyi mthar gsum brdeg len bsdus pa can byas la/ rnga rol bzhag oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi nī/ tsanḍa lī/ rakṣa si/ siṅga lī/ de wi sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul la/ sku gsum mngon gyur ma'i tshig rkang gnyis la/ dpal ldan dbang ldan ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo bcas/ de phyin chad 'dur gdangs kyi mthar gsum brdeg len bsdus pa can byas la rnga rol bzhag dbus kyi gtor ma la dmigs nas sngags thung la gtor sngags btags pa bdun dang / sngags ring tshar gsum gyis 'bul/ mtha'i gtor ma bdun la a kā ro gsum gsum gyis bsngo ba ste nyi shu rtsa gcig gis phul ba'i mthar/ dur khrod gnas brgyad ma'i tshig la mgon po 'khor shlau ka gsum/ dang ma'i mchod dbyangs/ dus phyis 'di la rang dbyangs zer/ de phyin 'dur gdangs 'di'i tshig rkang gi mtha' tshig mi 'dra ba rnams mi brjod par zhal bzhi gnyan po'i spyan sngar 'bul/ de bzhin du zhal bzhi gnyan po'i dbu la༞ zhal bzhi gnyan po'i shangs la༞ zhal bzhi gnyan po'i spyan la༞ zhal bzhi gnyan po'i thugs la༞ zhal bzhi gnyan po'i ljags la༞ zhal bzhi gnyan po'i snyan la 'bul/ zhal bzhi gnyan po'i zhal du 'bul/ zhes sbyar/ rdzogs mtshams su tshig rol/ hūm̐ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las sprul pa'i sku shlau ka gcig la sngon tshe ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin chad 'dur gdangs/ bla ma dmod sogs zhing bcu tshang ba 'di/ zhes pa'i rjes su rol mo blangs la bzhes shig sod gcig zhal du khā raṃ khā hi zhes pa nas thal ba'i rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod kyi bar bsdus dang ma bsdus pa bzhin la nam gcig gi rjes su rol mo gsum brdeg du bsgyur tshul mdos chen gyi dbyangs res skabs rnams dang 'dra/ rtsa ltung gi bshags pa tshig rkang lnga la nag po mchod rten gyi bshags dbyangs rol mo/

de phyin 'dur gdangs tshig mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bcu gcig par gyur mthol lo bshags/ de bzhin du bcu gnyis par gyur/ bcu gsum par gyur/ bcu bzhi par gyur mthol lo bshags/ zhes sbyar/ bcu pa yan gzhung bzhin no/ /de ltar lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ mthu chen sdang ba shlau ka gcig la nag po gnod sbyin ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin 'dur gdangs/ bdag la sdang bar byed pa yi zhes pa'i rjes su/ rol mo blangs la dgra bgegs zungs shig dam du chings zhes pa nas/ rigs brgyud bcas pa brlag par mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i phrin bcol gyi mjug gi rol mo bzhin/ bstan pa rgyas par bya'i phyir nas/ phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub par mdzod kyi rjes/ rol mo gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas la bzhag gtor ma mtheb skyus kha gsos/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi sogs shlau ka gcig gi mthar tshig rol chems brdung sngags rkang gling g.yab dar bcas rol bskor 'bebs grub rjes/ sngags thung la gtor sngags btags pa gsum dang sngags ring gcig a kā ro bdun rnams kyis phul ba'i mthar mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ sngags thung gi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung sogs 'phrin bcol gsung rgyun bzhin/ gang gzungs 'jug kyi skabs su bshad pa'i bshags pa tshar gcig khyed thugs ma gsum/ dpal rdo rje sogs nas/ mthol lo bshags so bzod pa dam pa bzhes kyi bar/ lha mchog ma la mchod dbyangs khams gdangs ma/ gdong bzhi dregs pa rdzogs nas gtor ma gso ba/

bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs nas bshags pa rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin la lha mchog ma shur ma/ yang gtor ma gso ba sogs 'dra ba las rakta dmar chen ma la dbyangs/ yang gtor ma gso ba 'dra ba las/ lha mchog ma'i mchod dbyangs 'dur gdangs ma/ yang gzhan 'dra ba las dam rdzas brgyan dang ma la dbyangs/ yang gzhan 'dra ba lha mchog ma la mchod dbyangs thung ba/ yang gzhan 'dra ba las khyed thugs ma la gdangs ring gzhug nas mdzad/ gdong bzhi dregs pa ma'i dbyangs rol rdzogs nas/ stobs chen shug drag ma shlau 'di la 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i khams mdong ma dang gang ma gnyis khyed mthun ma ring thung zhes gsungs pa'ang 'dug ka gcig la mi 'gyur ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin 'dur gdangs rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po nag po che shlau ka gcig la srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo/ de phyin 'dur gdangs dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i shlau ka gcig la srid bzhi ma'i dbyangs rol/ de kun khyed kyis myur du sgrub kyi bar/ bhyoḥgayung mo gtum mo srin mo dang / /sing ga la yi gling pa mo/ /zhes pa la gang sku ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin 'dur gdangs/ dam rdzas gtor ma 'di rang la zhes pa'i rjes su rol mo blangs la/ rgyob rgyob bdag gi dgra la rgyob nas/ rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog gi bar la sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i phrin bcol mjug gi rol mo bzhin/ bhyoḥbhyoḥkṣiṃ kṣiṃ nas/ rtag tu sdong grogs mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i rjes su gsum len can byas rgyas pa la bzhag rang nyid kyai rdo rje gsal ba'i snying rin po che padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad kha gyen la lta ba/ de'i steng du glo ba rin po che las grub pa'i padma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha thur du bstan pa/ de gnyis kha sbyar te bar mtshams med pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i steng du drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnam pa rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/

sku mdog ston gyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'am baiḍūrya sngon po'i mdangs can/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal gcig pa'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba thams cad la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa/ phyags g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nag cing snum pa'i ral pa'i thor cog lcang lo'i rlung g.yab dang bcas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ lang 'tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ mthong thos dran pas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mdzad pa/ sku che chung sor bzhi tsam blta bas chog mi shes 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing kha gyen du langs pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi rgyun dkar ba/ gsal ba dwangs pa 'od 'phro ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin shel dkar zhu ba'i rgyun lta bu dpag tu med pa chi li li babs pas bla ma mi bskyod pa'i sku'i cha shas thams cad mer gyis khengs thugs brgyud zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos mnyes/ bdag la mi dges pa dang dam tshig nyams chags sogs 'khon gcugs su gyur pa thams cad skad cig de nyid la sangs kyis dag dges shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun chen po chil gyis babs pas/ snying kha'i padma kha sbyor gyi nang gang / lus sems thams cad bde chen gyi ye shes kyis khyab/ nad gdon sdig sgrib khyad par chos skyong gi 'khu ldog 'khon gcugs thams cad byang zhing dag

snang ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod la he ru ka'i yig brgya lnga bcu shib bu dang de nas 'ur 'don bcas/ oṃ shrī tsa turmu kha sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ tsa turmu kha twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su twa ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān tsa turmu kha ma me muñtsa/ tsa turmu kha/ ko bha wa ma hā sa mā ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lnga bcu bzlas pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste nas/ byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol gyi bar kyai rdor bzhin la/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu rang gi snying gar thim pas brgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas mdun gyi bum pa la dung chos dang rdor gzungs gang yang mi dgos pa nang rdzas rnams dag byed kyi rdzas nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags/ oṃ bi shudhe sogs nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ rten dang mchod gtor rnams kyi drung du stegs mtho bar khrus gzhong bzhag la/ las kyi rdo rjes bum pa me long sku phyis rnams bzung / dpon slob rnams bzhengs la zhwa gyon/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril bzung / gzhan rnams kyis rnga rol dung sogs khyer la/ dmigs pa ni spyod 'jug las/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bar bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla res bres pa der/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du chos skyong 'khor bcas la sku khrus gsol bar bsam la/ gdangs dang bcas ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sogs kyi mthar rol mo'i sgra rgya cher byas la sku khrus gsol/ de dag sku la sogs kyis sku phyis phul nas bum chu rten dang mchod gtor thams cad la gtor la/

oṃ bi shuddhe sogs lan bdun brjod nas dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod/ bcom dung sngon 'gro'i bcom rol 'phar med gsum brdeg byas la/ dpal ldan srid gsum ma'i dbyangs rol phyag len bzhin gyi mthar/ mchog dang thun mong kun stsol cig gi rjes su rol mo gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa byas la bzhag tshogs 'khor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las sogs kyai rdor bdud rtsi'i byin brlabs bzhin oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ las kyi rdo rjes ma da na'i phud bskang gtor gyi drung gi snod dang phyag mtshan gyi ka pā la'i nang du cung zad blugs/ dpon slob rnams kyis thal mo sbyar la/ dman pa'i yul las nas/ bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig gi bar/ yang las kyi rdo rjes tshogs phud nas/ bsdus pa bskang gtor gyi drung dang gtor skyong gi gtor ma so so la phul/ slob dpon rnams kyis zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing sogs shlau ka gcig gi mthar/ kyai rdor gtor sngags dang / mgon po lcam bral gyi sngags rnams tshar re re dang / zhal gyi gtor sngags thung ba tshar gsum/ sngags ring tshar gcig dur khrod bdag po nas/ phur srung gi bar tshar re brjod la bsngos/ las kyi rdo rjes bza' ba g.yas dang btung ba g.yon du khyer la/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang po ltos sogs dang / slob dpon rnams kyis lag pa bsnol nas g.yas kha phub kyis za ba dang / g.yon kha slong ba'i btung ba la reg pa'i stangs ka byas la/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med sogs brjod la tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsdus la nyi ma ma zhud na spos dang / zhud na dpal 'bar btsugs phud chang dang lhan cig slob dpon gyi drung du bzhag dpon slob rnams kyis he ru ka'i yig brgya 'bru gsum/ a kā ro rnams lan re brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas kha phru 'debs tshul byas la/

phaiṃ/ uṣatsi ṭa sogs brjod la/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams tshim par gyur cig zhes dang / las kyi rdo rjes phyir dor/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdor glu bkra shis smon lam brjod nas gtor 'bul rgyun bzhin gyi rjes su/ zhal gyi sgos bstabs shlau ka gcig la lha mo'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs/ de 'phros sman raka phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig gi bar 'dur ma/ sngar bcol legs pa nas/ khyod bzhugs ma'i dbyangs byas la bzlog pa dang zhes pa'i rjes su rol mo blangs nas tshig rkang gsum la rol mo brdeg lugs khyod bzhugs ma'i sod cig la dbyangs bcug pa bzhin gzhug gi dzar bcas/ phrin las bsgrub par mdzod kyi rjes su gsum brdeg dang 'then rkang gsum/ chems brdung dang drag dung gtor sngags brjod la thun gtor 'bul ba dang mi rkang gi sgra g.yab dar lan gsum g.yab/ mjug tu gsum brdeg lan can rgyas pa byas la srid zhi dpal 'byor ma/ dpal 'di rgyun du mdzad mgon ma hā kā la 'chams dbyangs/ mjug chog mdos chen lugs sogs/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas sa srib tsam la grol/ nyer bdun gyi snga dro nam zi la tshogs nas gnas yo byin brlabs/ dkar cha bzhi/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ gtor bsngo bshags pa rnams nyer drug dang 'dra/ bskang gso nyer bdun gyi dus gtor bzhin la/ de wi ko ṭa ma'i mjug tu 'jam rdor ma bzhag nas dur khrod bdag po sogs sbyor nag po mchod rten gyi mjug tu mgo dbyangs sngon 'gro'i gtum chen ma bdun gzhan yang ma ring mo'i dbyangs rol rdzogs nas/ de bdun bstod pa dpal dbang ma bzhag nas/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyis sogs/ phur srung bstod pa'i mjug tu gsum brdeg len can/ rgyas pa/ gtor skyong gi mchod pa/ gtor ma byin brlabs/ mdun bskyed nas bzung spyan 'dren lha mchog ma rdzogs pa'i bar nyer drug bzhin la/

de rjes 'jam rdor ma dbyangs rol/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang nas/ dam bzhag rgyas rgyas pa'i stsal du gsol gyi bar 'dra/ de nas zhal gyi sngags thung lnga brgya shib bu dang / sngags ring nyer gcig 'ur 'don byas pa'i mthar/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs 'phrin bcol gsung rgyun bzhin/ 'jig rten khams kyi ma nas/ gtor ma bsngos la bshags pa bya ba'i bar nyer drug bzhin dang / lha mchog ma gcig la khams gdangs/ gnyis shur ma/ yang gtor kha gso ba sogs lha mchog ma shur ma gsum/ yang gtor gso sogs lha mchog ma gsum gyi rjes ma la rakta dmar chen ma'i dbyangs/ yang gtor gso sogs lha mchog ma gsum gyi rjes ma la mchod dbyangs 'dur ma/ yang gtor gso sogs lha mchog ma gsum gyi rjes mar dam rdzas brgyan dang ma'i dbyangs/ yang gtor gso sogs lha mchog ma gsum gyi rjes mar mchod dbyangs 'dur ma/ yang gtor gso sogs dang bshags pa'i rjes su/ khyed thugs ma gdangs ring lha mchog ma gsum gyi rjes mar gdong bzhi dregs pa'i dbyangs rol rnams byas pa'i lha mchog ma nyer gcig 'gro/ stobs chen shugs drag nas/ khrus gsol rdzogs pa'i bar nyer drug bzhin/ bcom dung btang la bcom rol nyis brdeg 'phar ma/ dpal ldan dbang ldan ma la dbyangs bu dbyangs/ bla mas bcol pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod kyi rjes su rol mo gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa/ tshogs 'khor man chad nyer drug bzhin no/ /de ltar byas pas sgo gtum drag dung dang dus mtshungs tsam las grol/ nyer brgyad nam zir 'tshogs pa nas bzung gtor bsngo'i bzlas pa dang phrin bcol rdzogs pa'i bar nyer bdun bzhin/ phyag 'tshal sngon 'gro'i bshags pa gsum/ khyed thugs ma gdangs thung / bskang ba nyer brgyad dus gtor bzhin la lha mo'i spyan 'dren gyi rjes su dur bdag las mkhan dkar bdud kyi spyan 'dren rnams sbyar/

rdo rje 'chang dbang ma lha mchog ma bcas bzhag dur khrod bdag po nas/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ chos nyid ma'i bshags pa dbyangs med bdun/ chos nyid ma'i bzlog pa bdun byas pa'i dang po la dbyangs rol dang / rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa dang la rol mo/ thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bhyoḥl rol mo/ gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar la thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bhyoḥ'i bar dang mjug tu rol mo bdun pa la bdud kyi khram kha ston pa dang / skyes pa'i mda' zor 'phen pa gnyis la rol mo/ thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bhyoḥ thams cad rbod gtong steng du bhyoḥ ma hā kā la mthu rtsal can/ zhes sogs dang sbrel la de man chad kyi rol tshig bzlog dung bshags pa'i dbyangs rol/ bstod pa la khyod bzhugs ma bzhag bstod pa rdzogs nas/ gsum brdeg len can byas pa nas bzung gtor skyong gi lha mchog ma'i spyan 'dren rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ de na rdo rje 'chang dbang ma'i dbyangs rol/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang nas khrus rdzogs bar nyer bdun bzhin bcom dung bcom rol 'phar med gsum brdeg lugs khyod bzhugs ma'i dbyangs rol/ bla mas bcol ba'i sogs kyis mthar gsum brdeg len can/ rgyas pa/ tshogs 'khor man 'dra zhing grol dus kyang de mtshungs byung / nyer dgu la nam zir 'tshogs pa nas bzung khyod thugs ma gdangs thung bya ba'i bar nyer brgyad bzhin dgu gtor ji lta ba la/ zhal gyi sgos bskang bshags/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma'i gong du nag po mchod rten gyi bshags pa bdun/ bzlog bdun la rol mo phral lugs phyag len bzhin/ bstod pa la paṃ padma bzhag bstod pa rdzogs pa'i rol mo gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa/ nas bzung gtor skyong gi lha mchog ma'i spyan 'dren rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang 'thud nas khrus gsol rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ bcom dung bcom rol nyis brdeg 'phar med/

paṃ padma'i dbyangs rol/ bla mas bcol pa'i sogs kyi rjes su bzlog rol dgu brdung gcig bdag dang rgyu sbyor sogs bzlog pa tshar gcig dgu brdung rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa/ tshogs 'khor man 'dra bar byas pas grol dus kyang gong mtshungs byung / gnam gang nam zi la tshogs pa nas gtor bsngo'i 'phrin bcol rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra bshags pa gsum/ bskang ba nag po mchod rten ma bskang gsar spyan 'dren/ gang gi rang bzhin shur ma'i rjes su rol mo mi len par dur khrod bdag po dang sbrel/ nag po mchod rten la dbyangs rol dbyangs lugs/ kye bos ma rdzogs nas bskang gsar gyi bstan srung rgya mtsho dang / khyad par bstan pa'i dam rdzas ma gnyis dbyangs rol/ mgo dbyangs sngon 'gro'i gzhan yang ma bdun/ lha mchog ma bzhag nas/ dmag zor mar chos dbyings spros bral ma gsum/ mgo dbyangs sngon 'gro'i nag po gnod sbyin ma gsum/ bdud dpung kun 'joms ma/ dpal gyi bstan skyong ma/ dkar chung shur ma bdun/ sku dang gsung thugs ma bdun gyi bar ma la rol mo rtsa brgyud bla ma gsum/ nag po mchod rten gyi bshags pa/ byin brlabs thugs rje ma dbyangs rol/ de phyin bshags pa lnga spel ma grangs gsog 'phrin bcol bdun dbyangs bcas/ bstod pa ma skyes mkha' klong ma/ stong nyid ma bzhag nas dkar bstod rgyas pa/ bse mo bzhi'i 'phrin bcol rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa bya ba nas gzung gtor skyong gi lha mchog ma'i spyan 'dren rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i sogs shur ma'i rjes su khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang 'thud nas khrus rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ bcom dung bcom rol 'phar ma chung len rnams grub nas 'then rkang 'phar ma gsum drug brdung 'phar ma gcig stong nyid ma la dbyangs bu dbyangs/ 'jig rten dge zhing dar bar mdzod kyi rjes su dgu brdung gcig

bdag dang rgyu sbyor la dgu brdung gsum/ gsum brdeg len can/ rgyas pa/ tshogs 'khor man 'dra ba byas pa'i grol dus gong mtshungs/ tshes gcig la nam zir tshogs pa nas bzung gtor bsngo'i phrin bcol bar 'dra/ bshags pa gcig nag po mchod rten gyi spyan 'dren/ gang gi rang bzhin ma shur ma la dur khrod bdag po 'thud la chems brdung / byon skyems mgon po 'khor dang nas kyai bos ma rdzogs pa'i bar shur ma mgo dbyangs sngon 'gro'i gtum chen ma bdun/ lha mo'i sgos bskang mgo dbyangs/ gzhan yang ma med pa/ dmag zor ma dang / dur bdag pu tra'i sgos bskang mgo dbyangs/ rnam dag tshogs gtor ma bzhi'i dang po dang gnyis pa la dbyangs/ gsum pa la 'dur gdangs rol mo/ bzhi pa la dbyangs nag po gnod sbyin ma med pa/ mon bu pu tra 'dur gdangs rol mo/ bdud dpung kun 'joms ma/ dkar mo sgos bskang mgo dbyangs/ nag po mi zad ma'i mthar chems brdung / dpal gyi bstan skyong ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma shur ma gsum/ rtsa brgyud bla ma 'phrin bcol bdun rjes ma la 'dur gdangs rol mo/ bzlog pa thugs dam ma shur ma bzhin bshags pa/ bka' bsgo/ bstod pa hūm̐ yig ma la mi rtog ma bzhag pa/ bstod pa rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can rgyas pa bya ba nas bzung gtor skyong gi lha mchog ma'i spyan 'dren rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i la tshig rol stobs 'phrog ma'i spyan 'dren/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang nas lha mchog ma nyer gcig rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ de nas stobs 'phrog ma'i bskang ba rdzogs nas stobs chen shugs drag nas bzung khrus rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra/ bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg len 'phar med/ mi rtogs ma'i dbyangs rol/ bshad bsgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod kyi rjes su dgu brdung gnyis/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor dgu brdung drag bskul dgu brdung gi mthar chems brdung /

drag dung gsum brdeg len rgyas pa can tshogs 'khor man 'dra bar byas pa'i gral dus gong mtshungs/ gnam gang dang / tshes gcig gi bskang gso 'di gzim chung bskang ba nyi ma gnyis su phral nas dus gtor dang bsres pa'i lugs yin/ tshes gnyis la nam zir 'tshogs pa nas bzung bshags pa rdzogs pa'i bar tshes gcig bzhin/ bskang ba thugs dam ma sor bzhag la spyan 'dren byang shar ma dang bskang ba lha mchog ma bzhag bse khrab can la'ang gtor ma med pas mi dgos/ bstod pa rab 'bar ma la zhal bzhi phrin las bzhag nas 'dod khams ma'i rjes su rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 'phrin las sogs sbrel ma rdzogs nas gsum brdeg rgyas pa len can bya ba nas bzung spyan 'dren lha mchog rdzogs pa'i bar 'dra zhing / byang ha ha sogs la khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang 'thud nas dam bzhag bsdus pa'i bar bya/ dam bzhag rgyas par bzlas pa med pa 'jig rten khams kyi nas rtsa ltung gi bshags pa'i bar 'dra zhing thal ba'i rdul du rlogs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces rol mo 'phro can du bzhag bshags pa dbyangs med gsum/ de phyin 'dra zhing / lha mchog ma grangs gsog tshul nyer drug lugs/ khrus gsol rdzogs nas bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg 'phar med/ dpal ldan srid gsum ma shlau ka gcig la mi 'gyur ma'i dbyangs rol/ dpal ldan dbang ldan ma nag rngams ma bzhin/ g.yung mo gtum mo shlau ka gcig zhal bzhi phrin las bzhi'i dbyangs rol/ zhing skyong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang / /zhes sogs hūm̐ yig ma'i phrin bcol bzhin la/ bshad bsgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod kyi rjes su gsum brdeg len rgyas pa can/ tshogs kyi byin brlabs nas tshogs phud 'bul ba'i bar bya/ de nas yi dam gyi zlum gtor gnyis bzhag de man chad kyi dam rdzas rnams dang bkram bskang nag po mchod rten rnams thog khar stegs kyi steng du sgrub khang du bzhugs/

bzhugs rim dang mthun par gzhug su gsol ba'i drung du nas nag gi tshom bu dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod la mañdzi rnams sgrub khang du bsgrigs pa gzhan bshams pa'i khar gtor skyong gi gtor ma rnams dang / dug khrag kā li bzhag mdun du drag mchod bgrangs tshar thun gtor chang phud rnams bshams la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ gu gul gyis bdug slob dpon bzhugs sar rdo dril nang mchod 'thor nas rnams kyang bshams/ dpon slob rnams kyis ji ltar rigs pa'i sar/ pu tra bskul phyag len bzhin byas la rol mo bcu bzhi brdung gi rjes su nyis rdeg rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas nas gtor ma la zhal phyogs par gral la 'khod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs rgyas par bzhin byas la/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dag pa ye shes lnga'i ngo bo gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lte ba'i bsil ba'i tshal zhes sogs nas oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar/ bcom dung rol mo bcom la chems rdung rkang gling g.yab dar 'phar chung gsum/ gsum brdeg len can/ spyan 'dren 'jam rdor ma'i dbyangs rol gyi mthar chems brdung / rkang gling g.yab dar ro bcud brgyad ldan shlau ka gcig tshig rol chems brdung rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka mā la ye satwaṃ gyis gdan phul bas mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi ro gdan la bzhugs par bsam la/ dam rgya bcas nas/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa mā ya ma ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ thal mo sbyar la/ stobs 'phrog pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i mgon po zhes pa nas/ dngos grub dang bde legs thams cad stsal du gsol gyi bar brjod/ gtor chung sngags thung bdun dang sngags ring gsum gyi dbul 'khor rnams la a kā ro nyer gcig gis bsngos/

mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ sngags thung gi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ 'phrin bcol gsung rgyun bzhin/ rnga brdung dbyangs dang bcas pas mi rtog ma gzhung bzhin/ bcol ba'i phrin las myur du bsgrub kyi rjes su rol mo gsum brdeg bsdus pa/ rtsa ltung gi bshags pa dbyangs bcas tshar gcig nag po chen po mche ba can shlau ka gcig la dpal ldan srid gsum ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin 'dur gdangs/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs yongs 'tshe la zhes pa'i rjes su rol mo blangs la rgyob rgyob chings chings mā ra ya/ tshos tshos bsgral ba'i kṣiṃ kṣiṃ gyis/ gtor ma 'di zo 'di longs shig zhes pa'i bar sangs rgyas bstan srung ma'i phrin bcol mjug gi rol mo bzhin la/ mjug tu nem gcig gi rjes su gsum brdeg tu bsgyur/ spyi bstabs gtor spod kyi gtor 'bul bzhin bla ma'i bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod kyi rol mo'i rjes su nyis brdeg 'phar ma byas la zhal gyi sgos bstabs tshig rkang gnyis la nam mkha' 'brug sgra'i dbyangs rol/ de rjes tshig rkang gnyis la sgar dbyangs/ de man chad la khyod bzhugs ma'i dbyangs bcug la shlau ka re la dzar dang rol mo/ 'dir gshegs brgyan gyi sogs gong du thun gtor 'bul skabs sor bzhag byas la 'dir gshegs ma tshugs pa dang gtor gdugs rnams bsdu/ sdang ba'i dgra dang sogs tshig rkang gsum la rol mo byed pa'i bar la las kyi rdo rjes dpal 'bar gyi gtso gtor g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab kyi yum chen rnams kyi gtor ma la btsugs pa'i liṅga rnams dang / 'khor gtor gyi liṅga rnams g.yas bskor du bsregs/ gtor ma 'bul tshe chems brdung lan gnyis byed pa'i dang po drag dung dang gnyis pa la rkang gling g.yab dar bcas/ de nas byang phyogs su kha bltas nas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma'i dbyangs rol rnams rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas nang du log

tshogs la longs spyod lhag ma btang mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ lhag chad kha bskang / nongs par bzod par gsol/ rten rnams la brtan bzhugs/ rten med pa'i ye shes pa dang tshom bu'i ye shes pa gdan sa 'di nyid du bzhugs pa yin na bris 'bur gyi sku gang rung la bstims/ gnas khang gzhan du lha brgyad dang gtso 'khor gsang rten dang spu gri so 'debs bsgom pa yin na de la bsdu zhing / gzhan rang gi rnying kha'i hūm̐ la thim pa'i dmigs pa bsgom/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /de ltar chog bsgrigs 'di sor bzhag la phyi rten 'dzugs pa'i cho ga bya ba'am ma byas kyang chog yig cha gsar rnying thams cad nas dam bzhag gi rjes su bzlas pa bya bar ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang chad skyon med cing / byas na'ang nyams chags bskang ba'i dmigs pa dang ldan zhing bzla ba yin pas lhag par mi 'gyur/ bskang gso dang grangs gsog dbyangs rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun nas byas pas chog go /zhes pa'i zin bris 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab kyi yi ge rnying ma rnams dang / kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ tshar chen yab sras rnams kyi gsung rab las btus te dbyangs rol gtor bshams rnams sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po 'jam mgon a mes zhabs rnams kyi gsung rgyun phyag len gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na dar zhing rgyas par bzhugs pa rnams kyis legs bar brgyan te go bde ba'i ngag gi bkod pa la chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //ces pa'i yi ge pa ni gso 'dzin pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis// //ka lya na wardhantu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ zhal bzhi pa'i gtor skyong dam tshig bskang gsor nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris/
